content: Plan: new forge/src/lean_smt_export.rs — automated Rust->Lean SMT-tactic exporter. Deliverables: committed lean/Thermite/SmtExport.lean (exporter-generated, root-imported, lake-build kernel-checked) + Rust golden test (file IS exporter output) + unit tests + lake-gated axiom-clean test (AC-8).
